text: Hi! I’m Momster. I’m so glad you’re here to help me chase away the pesky villains hanging around our house. When a villain stays too long, I can get pretty grumpy. But with your help, I can get back to my happiest mood: relaxed!
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: Before we begin, let me show you how it works. Listen closely, because I have an awesome reward for you at the end.
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: Each week, a different villain visits our house to cause chaos and spoil our fun. Every villain has a health bar. When that bar reaches zero, we win! Every task you finish takes away some of the villain’s health.
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: Some tasks and combos do extra damage. First, tap your card to open your profile. Pick the prize you’d like to earn this week. Then you’ll see a Special Mission and a Surprise Mission. You can choose your Special Mission now or come back to it later.
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: Your tasks are sorted into five groups: Morning, After School, Bedtime, Helper, and Bonus. Pick a group from the menu to see its tasks. When you finish one, tap its card to see how much damage you did to the villain.
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: See a siren in the top-right corner? Tap it to check any Special or Surprise Missions you haven’t finished yet. You can find them in Bonus, too. They often do extra damage and come with extra rewards!
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: For helping me, you’ll earn stars and coins. Each task card shows how many stars you can earn. You also get your very own hero helper! You can dress it up and it wears the treasures you find.
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: Collect stars to unlock stickers and badges in Hero HQ. When you reach the weekly star goal your family set, you’ll defeat the villain! You’ll also get one coin each time you finish a task group, up to five coins a day. If you complete all the tasks in a day, you can also hatch a mystery egg, which awards you rare items for your hero helper or bonus coins! Defeat the weekly villain and you’ll get ten more coins.
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: And don’t stop there: until the next villain arrives, you’ll earn double coins for your tasks. You can keep collecting stars for stickers, too. Spend your coins on clothes, accessories, toys, pets, and backgrounds for your hero helper. Make it yours!
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
speaker: momster

text: You listened all the way through, so here’s that awesome reward I promised: 25 coins to get you started! Spend them on something for your hero helper, or save them for later. Now, let’s pick your first task and show that villain what we can do!
note: plays whatever sound option is chosen (tour.js)
